label: Read paper summary batch
description: Inspect or prepare a paper or read an adaptive, character-budgeted source batch. Inspect reports reusable source-versioned evidence and its resume cursor. There is no five-batch or 50-page cap. Read serially; durably append compact evidence before the next batch. Follow next_start AND next_offset exactly, with no overlap. Continue until has_more=false, or save an explicitly partial summary if the actual run budget is exhausted. Do not treat targeted or incomplete coverage as a full read.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact local document ID being summarized.
parameter_descriptions.action: Inspect metadata/readability, prepare unreadable extraction, or read a pages/chunks batch.
parameter_descriptions.start: For pages, the one-based page; for chunks, the zero-based chunk. Follow next_start exactly. Null resumes after existing checkpointed evidence, or starts at the beginning when none exists.
parameter_descriptions.offset: Character continuation within the first page/chunk, from next_offset. Null or 0 starts a fresh item; null with start=null resumes the durable cursor.
